items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: The Frank Sinatra recording session is probably correct.

ctx.x: crash while driving home from a Frank Sinatra recording session.
The Frank Sinatra recording session is probably correct. You can verify it with Red. Red is the one who informed me he was not driving, he was walking across the street.
I always thought he had gotten loaded and was driving, but the woman who was driving was loaded.
